meta.title: Reading and influences
meta.note: The order of these links changes from time to time. That is intentional. Learning is rarely linear, and neither is change.

tiers.label: Start here
tiers.microCopy: A way in, not a conclusion.

items.name: Nesta
items.annotation: Clear, public-interest work on systems change, innovation, and technology grounded in real social outcomes.

items.name: Government Digital Service
items.annotation: Practical guidance shaped by delivery inside constrained public systems, not abstract theory.

items.name: Harvard Business Review – Open Articles
items.annotation: A shared reference point for leadership thinking, useful when read critically and selectively.

tiers.label: Go deeper
tiers.microCopy: When the simple explanations stop working.

items.name: Institute for Government
items.annotation: Evidence-led analysis of how government actually functions, including incentives, constraints, and trade-offs.

items.name: Oxford Review (Free Articles)
items.annotation: Evidence-based management writing that actively challenges fashionable narratives and intuition-led decisions.

items.name: Behavioural Scientist
items.annotation: Accessible but rigorous work on human behaviour, decision-making, and organisational life.

items.name: MIT Sloan Management Review – Free Content
items.annotation: Thoughtful analysis of organisational learning and transformation, beyond technology adoption alone.

tiers.label: Challenge your assumptions
tiers.microCopy: This may change how you see the problem.
